shots.beat: The world is wrong before anyone knows it: a bus where no road has ever been.

shots.narration: The 7:40 express left on time. The town it was heading for won't be built for another twelve thousand years.

foley: the bus engine ticking as it cools

shots.beat: Walter sees it first, and the others see him lose it.

frame.light: cold blue morning light under a low sky
relations: the yellow bus stands behind the four of them

sits hunched with headphones on her ears

blocking.pose: rubs his hands together for warmth
blocking.on: standing in snow up to his ankles

action.start: squints at the far snowy horizon

action.settle: holds both hands high, frozen, mouth wide open
action.face: his eyes bulge behind his glasses and his jaw drops

reactions.does: pulls her headphones down to her neck

shots.beat: He wants the road back; she wants him calm before the others panic.

frame.light: cold blue morning light under a low sky

action.peak: jabs a finger down at the snow at his feet, eyebrows shooting up
action.settle: stares at her with his mouth open

reactions.does: raises one eyebrow and tightens her folded arms

dialogue.text: There was a road. Right here!
dialogue.delivery: high and fast, close to cracking

shots.beat: Her calm turns into the first admission that something is truly wrong.

dialogue.text: Walter. Buses don't drive through glaciers.

shots.beat: No signal: nobody is coming to help.

shots.beat: The turn: something enormous is behind them.

holds her phone at her chest
